name: Walkthrough
description: 把 Git diff、提交范围或当前会话的改动收成一步步的讲解：每步有标题、说明和对应代码，可以改文字，一次看一步。

agentTools.name: walkthrough_build
agentTools.description: Build a stepped walkthrough from a git diff in the current project and show it in the Walkthrough sidebar. Sources: session (commits since the current Enso session checkpoint, otherwise uncommitted changes), worktree, staged, branch, or commits (last N or a base..head range). Explanations are derived from the diff and commit messages; the user can edit them. Does not send the diff to a model.

count.description: When kind is commits and range is omitted, how many recent commits (default 5).

range.description: Commit range such as HEAD~5..HEAD when kind is commits.

base.description: Base branch when kind is branch. Defaults to origin/HEAD, origin/main, or main.

agentTools.name: walkthrough_edit
agentTools.description: Edit the title or explanation of an existing walkthrough. Pass stepId to change that step; omit stepId to change the overall title or summary. Edited text is kept when the same change is rebuilt.

walkId.description: Walkthrough id. Defaults to the latest one.

stepId.description: Step id from walkthrough_build. Required when setting body.

agentTools.name: walkthrough_current
agentTools.description: Read the current project's saved walkthrough: title, summary, and each step's id, title, and explanation.
